title: Yahadian language - Wikipedia
text: Yahadian is a member of the Trans-New Guinea languages, spoken on the northwestern corner of the island of New Guinea. Three villages speak Yahadian: Mugim, Yahadian, and (parts of) Kais, with an estimated 1,200 speakers in 2002. [1] They are all located on the south side of the Bird's Head peninsula in Indonesia.
